newsitem.title: UK: Shield up again as bid talk refuses to die.
newsitem.headline: Shield up again as bid talk refuses to die.

text.p: Shares in drug research group Shield Diagnostics Plc rose on Thursday amid continuing talk British Biotechnology Plc would bid for Shield and on rumours of a pending positive note from UBS, dealers said.
By 0820 Shield shares were up 45p or ten percent to 542-1/2p, extending Wednesday's 45p advance.
"There are a number of stories out in the market", one trader said.

Despite a denial from British Biotech on Wednesday that it had any intention of bidding for Shield, a report in the Times newspaper ctoday said the stock had continued to be supported by whispers of a bid from the biotechnology group.
British Biotech on Wednesday dismissed an earlier Times report, saying Biotech was not looking at an acquisition of the size of Shield.
Apart from the bid speculation, there was also talk of a "buy" recommendation from UBS, dealers said.
Market sources said UBS was due to issue a research report on Shield but analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
